title: An Empirical Evaluation of Generic Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Sequence Modeling

paper.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Generic Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Sequence Modeling
paper.authors: Shaojie Bai, J. Zico Kolter, Vladlen Koltun
paper.summary: Shows that a simple temporal convolutional network with causal, dilated convolutions and residual blocks matches or beats recurrent networks on many sequence tasks.
